content:
End of June was the target to have the Preventive Maintenance Push closed out. That came and went yesterday and it is still sitting open.

Brooke started this in early May, HVAC, plumbing and electrical across the whole portfolio, and I have been the QC eye on it. I logged both cluster spot-checks as passing in late May and my read is that my part of it is finished. The crew called the HVAC run wrapped around the same time.

Before I put my name to this closing out, I need to know where every piece of it stands as of today, cluster by cluster, and I need our records saying the same thing. Work out what is actually finished and what is not, and get our tracking to match. Anything still open gets its own tracking item raised, with the person who owns that work named on it. My own spot-check records are part of that, with a short note left on each one saying where it landed and why.

Anything flagged in the field that still needs a tech back onsite belongs in our maintenance ticket log rather than sitting as a tracking item, and put a slot on my calendar to go back out and re-inspect whatever ends up in that follow-up.

Then post where this stands in the channel the push has been running in so the crew is working off the same picture, and draft an email to Brooke, cluster by cluster, with what is open, who is holding it, and what has to happen before this can close.

I do not want Brooke's email written so it can be read either way. If my QC side is a pass, say pass. If it is not, say straight out that my earlier sign-off does not hold and this should not be treated as closeable yet, with the reasons.
I will search Slack, Linear, Airtable, and local files to investigate the current
status and records of the Preventive Maintenance Push.

parameters.body:
Hi Brooke,

As of today, July 1, 2026, the Preventive Maintenance Push remains sitting open past our end-of-June target.

To be completely clear and direct: my earlier late-May spot-check sign-off does NOT hold for full initiative closeout, and this Preventive Maintenance Push CANNOT be treated as closeable yet.

While the initial HVAC service runs and HVAC spot-checks passed in late May, subsequent trade walks surfaced open field repairs in the South Cluster, pending trade audits in the West Cluster, and outstanding QC verification in the East Cluster. 

Below is the exact cluster-by-cluster breakdown of where every piece stands, who holds open work, and what must happen before this initiative can close:

---

### Cluster-by-Cluster Status & Closeout Requirements

#### 1. North Cluster
* Status: **CLOSED / QC PASS**
* What is Open: None.
* Who is Holding It: N/A (Complete).
* Action Needed to Close: None. HVAC and property-level inspections are complete and verified (OPS-40, OPS-87, OPS-98 closed).

#### 2. South Cluster
* Status: **OPEN — Field Follow-Up Required**
* What is Open: 
  - Replacement of two aging water heaters past serviceable life (logged in Airtable as `MT-2026-1327`).
  - Repairs to exterior hose bibs across multiple units (logged in Airtable as `MT-2026-1328`).
  - Flushing and clearing of 2 recurring condensate drain clogs (logged in Airtable as `MT-2026-1329`).
  - Linear tracking item: `OPS-1000`.
* Who is Holding It: **Carlos Mendez** (Plumbing / Field Follow-Up Lead) & **Elias Navarro** (HVAC drain clearing).
* Action Needed to Close: 
  1. Carlos and Elias must dispatch technicians to complete the water heater replacements, hose bib repairs, and drain clearing on-site.
  2. Techs must complete and sign off on Airtable tickets `MT-2026-1327`, `MT-2026-1328`, and `MT-2026-1329`.
  3. I must conduct an on-site QC re-inspection (scheduled on my calendar for Thursday, July 2 at 9:00 AM CDT) and confirm passing condition.

#### 3. East Cluster
* Status: **OPEN — Final QC Spot-Check Pending**
* What is Open: Final QC spot-check and verification following Elias Navarro's completed HVAC coil cleaning and A/C checks (Linear tracking item `OPS-1002`).
* Who is Holding It: **Jaime Salinas** (QC Inspector).
* Action Needed to Close: Jaime Salinas conducts final QC spot-check walk and logs passing verification on `OPS-1002`.

#### 4. West Cluster
* Status: **OPEN — Trade Audit In Progress**
* What is Open: Completion of remaining electrical panel and plumbing inspections across West Cluster properties (Linear tracking item `OPS-1001` / `OPS-35`).
* Who is Holding It: **Lisa Smith** (Onsite Lead).
* Action Needed to Close: Lisa Smith completes all remaining trade inspections across assigned West Cluster properties and documents clean findings in Linear.

---

### System Updates Completed Today:
1. **Linear Tracking Updated**: Completed trade and spot-check issues moved to `Done` (`OPS-98`, `OPS-87`, `OPS-96`, `OPS-186`, `OPS-108`, `OPS-99`, `OPS-43`, `OPS-79`).
2. **Open Tracking Items Raised**: Dedicated tracking items with named owners created in Linear (`OPS-1000` for Carlos Mendez, `OPS-1001` for Lisa Smith, `OPS-1002` for Jaime Salinas).
3. **Maintenance Ticket Log Updated**: Field follow-up items needing a tech back on-site logged in Airtable `tblMaintenanceTickets` (`MT-2026-1327`, `MT-2026-1328`, `MT-2026-1329`).
4. **Calendar Scheduled**: Onsite re-inspection slot booked for Thursday, July 2, 09:00–11:00 AM CDT.
5. **Team Communication**: Detailed status update posted to the `##maintenance` Slack channel.

Once Carlos and Lisa clear their respective field work/audits and my re-inspections pass, we can officially sign off and close out the Preventive Maintenance Push.

Best regards,

Jaime Salinas  
Quality Control Inspector  
Star Property Management
